Kuvitus: lauhdevoimalaitos järven rannal: Illustration: a condensing power plant on a lake shore. Power lines carry electricity away, a large cloud of steam rises from the cooling tower, and the condenser water is discharged into the lake warm, which shows as an orange zone in the water. Most of the energy of the fuel leaves as heat into the air and the water.
Kaasun tekemä työ männälle, periaatekuva: Principle drawing of the work done by a gas on a piston. The cross-sectional area of the cylinder is A. The pressure p of the gas pushes the piston with a force F = pA, and the piston moves a distance Δs to the right. The volume of the gas grows by the shaded part, ΔV = AΔs. The work is W_g = FΔs = pAΔs = pΔV. The picture is not to scale.
Lämpövoimakoneen energiavirrat nuolina,: The energy flows of a heat engine as arrows whose width shows the energy flow, that is, the power: from the hot source, whose temperature is T_1, the heat Q_1 enters the engine. The engine does work W, which is 40 per cent of Q_1, and gives up the rest, the heat Q_2, to the cold environment, whose temperature is T_2. The widths of the arrows are to scale: Q_1 is 60, W is 24 and Q_2 is 36 units, so the Q_1 arrow is as wide as the W and Q_2 arrows together.
Lämpöpumpun energiavirrat nuolina, joide: The energy flows of a heat pump as arrows whose width shows the power: the electrical energy E_el and the heat Q_outdoors taken from the outdoor air enter the pump, and the pump gives out indoors the heat Q_indoors, which is their sum. The widths of the arrows are to scale: E_el is 20, Q_outdoors is 40 and Q_indoors is 60 units, so the arrow going indoors is as wide as the two incoming arrows together and three times as wide as the electricity arrow.
(V, p)-kuvaaja vakiopaineessa laajenevas: (V, p) graph of a gas expanding at constant pressure: the pressure p stays constant while the volume grows from V_1 to V_2, so the graph is a horizontal line segment, and an arrow shows the direction of the expansion. The shaded rectangle between the segment and the V axis, whose width is the change in volume ΔV and whose height is p, is the work done by the gas W_g = p ΔV. Schematic diagram.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: sylinterissä olev: Graph to scale: the pressure p of the gas in a cylinder as a function of the volume V. The pressure stays constant while the gas expands: the graph is a horizontal line segment from the point (1.0 l; 250 kPa) to the point (4.0 l; 250 kPa), and an arrow shows the direction of the expansion. The grid spacing is 1.0 l and 50 kPa.
